t: Time 3093Y white flexible cable is purpose-built for storage heaters and heating element installations. This 25m drum houses a robust 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The larger 1.5mm² conductor area manages higher current demands, whilst the heat-resistant PVC sheath operates reliably between -15°C and 90°C. With 27 x strands per core, the cable maintains exceptional flexibility for demanding heating applications and complex routing requirements.
b: Suitable for Storage Heaters & Heating Elements
